subject.title: [Bug] Docker sandbox container name collision across multiple instances on same host

question: Should OpenClaw accept workspace-scoped non-shared sandbox runtime identity, including the documented one-time runtime reset, as the fix for this co-hosted instance isolation bug?
rationale: The source-proven bug crosses a sandbox security boundary, and the active fix changes runtime identity and upgrade behavior in a compatibility-sensitive path.

options.title: Accept workspace-scoped identity
options.body: Land the active workspace-scoped fix after maintainer review and accept the documented one-time non-shared runtime reset.

options.title: Require migration first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a doctor or migration path if preserving existing non-shared runtime state matters before merge.

options.title: Choose another identity policy
options.body: Pause the candidate PR and define a different stable instance discriminator for sandbox runtime identity.

recommendation.title: Accept workspace-scoped identity
recommendation.body: Land the active workspace-scoped fix after maintainer review and accept the documented one-time non-shared runtime reset.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current and historical connection to the affected sandbox security/runtime code path.
